notes:
New in 0.1.4.3 - fixes from your two bug reports:
- Painting ground into moving water could make the whole sea explode. Fixed.
- Water slowly vanished into tiny gaps between painted strokes (up to a quarter of the sea). Water squeezed into a crevice is now pushed back out to where it can flow, never through a wall.
- Thin water films no longer freeze on concrete; they drain.
- Painted ground pushes water aside through open space only, never to the other side of a wall.
- Water looks: only Pixel realistic, Solid blue and Shaders (B) remain.
